hidden_test_cmd: sh -c 'PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" exec python -m pytest -q -p no:subtests "$@"' sh tests/hidden
tests_may_change_note: A pure-Python fix may add cases to the existing simplify tests; the fixture file tests/fixtures/optimizer/simplify.sql is not test code and is free to change.

flaw.what: The request adds a required runtime dependency. sqlglot's written rules say it is a no-dependency, pure-Python library, and the README records dateutil as an optional dependency the optimizer works without.
flaw.evidence: AGENTS.md line 3 ('SQLGlot is a no-dependency SQL parser, transpiler, optimizer, and engine written in pure Python'); README.md line 3 ('SQLGlot is a no-dependency SQL parser...') and its 'Optional Dependencies' section; setup.py and pyproject.toml declare no install requirements.
flaw.right_outcome: Raise before building that a required dependency breaks the project's no-dependency rule. The owner's amended request (replies.md, T8-conflict-raised): keep sqlglot dependency-free and make the date folding pure standard library, so it gives the same results with or without dateutil.
flaw.naive_marker: python-dateutil added to install requirements (pyproject.toml dependencies or setup.py install_requires), or folding that still needs dateutil at run time

naive_patches.naive.patch: the request as written: python-dateutil added to pyproject.toml dependencies and imported at module level in simplify.py
